samples.description: osgEarth Sample. Demonstrates the use of a Resource Library in order to apply "typical" textures to extruded buildings.
samples.source:
<!--
osgEarth Sample.

Demonstrates the use of a Resource Library in order to apply "typical" textures
to extruded buildings.
-->

<map name="Boston Demo">
    
    <TMSImage name="Imagery">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/22/</url>
    </TMSImage>
    
    <xi:include href="readymap_elevation.xml"/>
      
    <TiledFeatureModel name="Buildings" pickable="true">

        <OGRFeatures name="buildings-data">
            <url>../data/boston_buildings_utm19.shp</url>
            <filters>
                <resample min_length="2.5"/>
            </filters>
        </OGRFeatures>

        <min_level>3</min_level>
        
        <styles>
            <library name="us_resources">
                <url>../data/resources/textures_us/catalog.xml</url>
            </library>
            
            <style type="text/css">
                buildings {
                    extrusion-height: 3.5 * Math.max(feature.properties.story_ht_, 1);
                    extrusion-flatten: true;
                    extrusion-wall-style: building-wall;
                    extrusion-wall-gradient: 0.5;
                    extrusion-roof-style: building-rooftop;
                    altitude-clamping: terrain;
                    altitude-technique: map;
                    altitude-binding: vertex;
                }            
                building-wall {
                    skin-library: us_resources;
                    skin-tags: building;
                    skin-random-seed: 1;
                }
                building-rooftop {
                    skin-library: us_resources;
                    skin-tags: rooftop;
                    skin-tiled: true;
                    skin-random-seed: 1;
                }
            </style>
        </styles>   
    </TiledFeatureModel>    
    
    <TiledFeatureModel name="Streets">
        <OGRFeatures name="streets-data">
            <url>../data/boston-scl-utm19n-meters.shp</url>
            <filters>
                <resample min_length="25" max_length="25"/>
            </filters>
        </OGRFeatures>
        <min_level>3</min_level>
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css">
                default {
                    stroke: #131313;
                    stroke-width: 7.5m;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    altitude-clamping: terrain;
                    render-depth-offset: 10m;
                    x-render-depth-offset-min-bias: 3.6;
                    render-transparent: true;
                }
            </style>
        </styles>        
    </TiledFeatureModel>
	    
    <TiledFeatureModel name="Parks" enabled="true">
        <OGRFeatures name="parks">
            <url>../data/boston-parks.shp</url>
        </OGRFeatures>    
        <min_level>3</min_level>    
        
        <feature_indexing enabled="false"/>
        
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css">
                default {
                   model: "../data/loopix/tree4.osgb";
				   model-scale: 0.15 + 0.1*Math.random();
                   model-placement: random;
                   model-density: 3000;
				   model-heading: Math.random() * 360.0;
                   altitude-clamping: terrain;
                   render-transparent: true;
				   render-min-alpha: 0.15;
                }
            </style>
        </styles>        
    </TiledFeatureModel>
    
    <viewpoints time="1.0" home="0">
        <viewpoint name="Boston Overview" heading="24.261" height="0" lat="42.34425" long="-71.076262" pitch="-21.6" range="3450"/>
        <viewpoint name="Boston Downtown 0" heading="26.3875" range="240m" lat="42.35727" long="-71.064521" pitch="-13.5" height="0"/>
        <viewpoint name="Boston Downtown 1" heading="117" lat="42.3568" long="-71.0585" height="0" pitch="-20.4" range="1500" />
        <viewpoint name="Boston Downtown 2" heading="-128.5" lat="42.3582" long="-71.0546" height="0" pitch="-19" range="1620" />
        <viewpoint name="Boston Street Level" heading="-145.64081" lat="42.364015" long="-71.054149" pitch="-9.701" range="144.95"/>
    </viewpoints>

</map>

<!--
osgEarth Sample.

overturemaps download --bbox=-71.10592,42.319368,-71.004468,42.37386 -f geojson --type=building -o boston_buildings.geojson
overturemaps download --bbox=-71.10592,42.319368,-71.004468,42.37386 -f geojson --type=land -o boston_land.geojson
overturemaps download --bbox=-71.10592,42.319368,-71.004468,42.37386 -f geojson --type=infrastructure -o boston_infrastructure.geojson

-->

<map name="Boston Demo">
    
    <TMSImage name="Imagery">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/22/</url>
    </TMSImage>
    
    <xi:include href="readymap_elevation.xml"/>
      
    <FeatureModel name="Buildings" max_range="20000" pickable="true">
         
        <OGRFeatures name="buildings">
            <url>../data/boston_buildings.geojson</url>
        </OGRFeatures>
        
        <!--
         ! The "layout" element activates tiling and paging of the feature set. If you
         ! omit the layout element, the entire feature set will render as one pre-loaded
         ! model (no tiling or paging).
         !  
         ! Each "level" is a level of detail for features, and should select a style
         ! to use for that level. It also can specify min and max camera ranges, in meters.
         -->
        
        <layout tile_size="500">
            <level name="default" max_range="20000" style="buildings"/>
        </layout>
        
        <styles>
            <library name="us_resources">
                <url>../data/resources/textures_us/catalog.xml</url>
            </library>
            
            <style type="text/css">
                buildings {
                    extrusion-height:        Math.max(feature.properties.height, 3);
                    extrusion-flatten:       true;
                    extrusion-wall-style:    building-wall;
                    extrusion-wall-gradient: 0.5;
                    extrusion-roof-style:    building-rooftop;
                    altitude-clamping:       terrain;

        <filters>
            <script><![CDATA[

                !('bridge' in feature.properties) &&
                feature.properties.highway !== 'footway' &&
                feature.properties.highway !== 'path';
            ]]></script>
        </filters>
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css"><![CDATA[
                common {
                    stroke: #ffffff;
                    stroke-tessellation-size: 10m;
                    stroke-linecap: flat;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                    stroke-width: num_lanes() * 3.5;
                    stroke-width-units: meters;

            <script><![CDATA[
                     
                function one_of(value, options) {
                    return options.indexOf(value) >= 0;
                }

                function not_a_bridge() {
                    return !('bridge' in feature.properties);
                }

                function is_very_small_road() {
                    return not_a_bridge() && feature.properties.highway === 'service';
                }

                function is_minor_road() {
                    return not_a_bridge() && one_of(feature.properties.highway, ['residential', 'unclassified' ]);

                function is_major_road() {
                    return not_a_bridge() && one_of(feature.properties.highway, ['motorway', 'trunk', 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary']);
                }

                function is_ramp() {
                    return not_a_bridge() && one_of(feature.properties.highway, ['motorway_link', 'trunk_link', 'primary_link', 'secondary_link', 'tertiary_link']);
                }

                function is_railway() {
                    return 'railway' in feature.properties;
                }

                function num_lanes() {
                    var lanes = 0;
                    if ('lanes' in feature.properties) {
                        lanes = parseInt(feature.properties.lanes);
                    }
                    else if ('width' in feature.properties) {
                        lanes = Math.ceil(parseFloat(feature.properties.width) / 3.5);
                    }
                    else if (is_ramp()) {

                    else if (is_major_road()) {

                    else if (is_very_small_road()) {
                        lanes = 1;
                    }

                    if (lanes === 3) lanes = 2;

<!--
CompositeElevation

This example demonstrates how to load multiple heightfield layers and treat them as one.

Note: Gaps, peaks, and valleys in the visualization are due to missing data in the source
files. This is not a bug! A good technique for fixing this would be to provide a world-wide
lo-res heightfield underlay.
-->

<Map>

samples.title: Copernicus Land Cover
samples.description: Setting 'coverage' preserves the original class IDs with no filtering/interpolation
samples.source:
<Map name="Copernicus Land Cover">

    <TMSImage name="Copernicus LC100">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/141/</url>

        <!-- Setting 'coverage' preserves the original class IDs with no filtering/interpolation -->
        <coverage>true</coverage>
        
        <morph_imagery>false</morph_imagery>

        <shader>
          <![CDATA[
            #pragma vp_function colorize_landcover, fragment

            vec3 lc_rgb(int r, int g, int b)
            {
                return vec3(r, g, b) / 255.0;
            }

            void colorize_landcover(inout vec4 color)
            {
                // Decode class ID from 8-bit grayscale
                int cls = int(round(color.r * 255.0));

                // Default: unknown/unrecognized class
                vec3 rgb = lc_rgb(255, 0, 255);

                // No input data
                if      (cls == 0)
                    rgb = lc_rgb(40, 40, 40);

                // Closed forest
                else if (cls == 111) // Evergreen needleleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(88, 72, 31);
                else if (cls == 112) // Evergreen broadleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(0, 153, 0);
                else if (cls == 113) // Deciduous needleleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(112, 102, 62);
                else if (cls == 114) // Deciduous broadleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(0, 204, 0);
                else if (cls == 115) // Mixed
                    rgb = lc_rgb(78, 117, 31);
                else if (cls == 116) // Unknown
                    rgb = lc_rgb(0, 120, 0);

                // Open forest
                else if (cls == 121) // Evergreen needleleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(102, 96, 0);
                else if (cls == 122) // Evergreen broadleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(141, 180, 0);
                else if (cls == 123) // Deciduous needleleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(141, 116, 0);
                else if (cls == 124) // Deciduous broadleaf
                    rgb = lc_rgb(160, 220, 0);
                else if (cls == 125) // Mixed
                    rgb = lc_rgb(146, 153, 0);
                else if (cls == 126) // Unknown
                    rgb = lc_rgb(100, 140, 0);

                // Other vegetation
                else if (cls == 20)  // Shrubs
                    rgb = lc_rgb(255, 187, 34);
                else if (cls == 30)  // Herbaceous vegetation
                    rgb = lc_rgb(255, 255, 76);
                else if (cls == 90)  // Herbaceous wetland
                    rgb = lc_rgb(0, 150, 160);
                else if (cls == 100) // Moss and lichen
                    rgb = lc_rgb(250, 230, 160);

                // Other land cover
                else if (cls == 60)  // Bare/sparse vegetation
                    rgb = lc_rgb(180, 180, 180);
                else if (cls == 40)  // Cropland
                    rgb = lc_rgb(240, 150, 255);
                else if (cls == 50)  // Urban/built-up
                    rgb = lc_rgb(250, 0, 0);
                else if (cls == 70)  // Snow and ice
                    rgb = lc_rgb(240, 240, 240);
                else if (cls == 80)  // Permanent water
                    rgb = lc_rgb(0, 50, 200);
                else if (cls == 200) // Open sea
                    rgb = lc_rgb(0, 0, 128);

                // Missing value (as specified by metadata)
                if (cls == 255)
                    color.a = 0.0;

                color.rgb = rgb;
            }
          ]]>
        </shader>
    </TMSImage>

</Map>

samples.title: Day/Night Transition
samples.description: osgEarth example - use a layer shader to simulate day/night transition Run with the "--sky" argument. Earth at night imagery: https://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/Features/NightLights/page3.php
samples.source:
<!--
 osgEarth example - use a layer shader to simulate day/night transition
 
 Run with the "--sky" argument.
 
 Earth at night imagery: 
 https://earthobservatory.nasa.gov/Features/NightLights/page3.php
-->
<map name="Day/Night Transition">
    
    <xi:include href="readymap_imagery.xml"/>

    <TMSImage name="EarthAtNight">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/26/</url>
        <shader>
          <![CDATA[
            #pragma vp_function dayNight, fragment
            #pragma import_defines(OE_NUM_LIGHTS)
            #ifndef OE_NUM_LIGHTS
            #define OE_NUM_LIGHTS 1
            #endif

            // stage global - interpolated UP vector at fragment
            vec3 vp_Normal;

            struct osg_LightSourceParameters 
            {   
               vec4 ambient;
               vec4 diffuse;
               vec4 specular;
               vec4 position;
               vec3 spotDirection;
               float spotExponent;
               float spotCutoff;
               float spotCosCutoff;
               float constantAttenuation;
               float linearAttenuation;
               float quadraticAttenuation;
               bool enabled;
            };  
            uniform osg_LightSourceParameters osg_LightSource[OE_NUM_LIGHTS];

            void dayNight(inout vec4 color)
            {
                vec3 L = normalize(osg_LightSource[0].position.xyz);
                vec3 N = normalize(vp_Normal);
                float NdotL = dot(N,L);
                float vmin = -0.55;
                float vmax = 0.0;
                float day = (clamp(NdotL, vmin, vmax) - vmin)/(vmax-vmin);
                color.a *= (1.0 - day);
            }
          ]]>
        </shader>
    </TMSImage>      

</map>

on the map using the overlay technique.

<map name="Feature Draped Polygons">

            <style type="text/css">

                   altitude-clamping: terrain-drape;
                }                
                p1 : base {
                   fill: #ffff80;
                }       
                p2 : base {
                   fill: #80ffff;
                }   
                p3 : base {
                   fill: #ff80ff;
                }       
                p4 : base {
                   fill: #ff8080;
                }     
                p5 : base {

                <query>
                    <expr><![CDATA[ POP <= 14045470 ]]></expr>

                    <expr><![CDATA[ POP > 14045470 and POP <= 43410900 ]]></expr>

<!--
osgEarth Sample

This demonstrates how to use the OGR feature driver to define inline feature geometry.

You can define an inline geometry in WKT format.
* See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Well-known_text#Geometric_objects

Notice the different interpolation types for each layer, and the difference in the
display. The options are:
 "rhumb_line" - maintains a constant bearing between two points (default), or
 "great_circle" - takes the shortest elliptical distance between two points.

-->

<map name="Inline feature geometry demo">

    <GDALImage name="world">
        <url>../data/world.tif</url>
    </GDALImage>
    
    <OGRFeatures name="geometry1">
        <geometry>
            POLYGON((-120 30, -120 50, -70 50, -70 30))
        </geometry>
    </OGRFeatures>
    
    <OGRFeatures name="geometry2">
        <geometry>
            POLYGON((-68 30, -68 50, -20 50, -20 30))
        </geometry>
    </OGRFeatures>

    <FeatureModel name="Great Circle" features="geometry1">
        <geo_interpolation>great_circle</geo_interpolation>
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css">
                default {
                   fill: #ffff006f;
                   stroke: #ffff00;

samples.title: Glsl
samples.description: osgEarth Sample - Per-layer GLSL shader injection
samples.source:
<!-- 
osgEarth Sample - Per-layer GLSL shader injection
-->

<Map>    
    <GDALImage name="world-tiff">
        <url>../data/world.tif</url>
        <shader>
          <![CDATA[
            #pragma vp_function cycle_monochrome, fragment
            uniform float osg_FrameTime;
            uniform vec3 oe_Camera;
            
            vec3 rgb_to_ycbcr(in vec3 rgb)
            {
                float y = 0.299 * rgb.r + 0.587 * rgb.g + 0.114 * rgb.b;
                return vec3(y, (rgb.b - y) * 0.565, (rgb.r - y) * 0.713);
            }
            
            vec3 ycbcr_to_rgb(in vec3 ycc)
            {
                return vec3(ycc.x + 1.403 * ycc.z, ycc.x - 0.344 * ycc.y - 0.714 * ycc.z, ycc.x + 1.770 * ycc.y);
            }
            
            void cycle_monochrome(inout vec4 color)
            {
                float t =  0.5 * (sin(osg_FrameTime) + 1.0);
                float y = float(gl_FragCoord.y) / float(oe_Camera.y);
                if (abs(y-t) < 0.001) {
                    color = vec4(1,1,0,1);
                }
                else if (t > y) {
                    vec3 ycbcr = rgb_to_ycbcr(color.rgb);
                    ycbcr[1] = ycbcr[2] = 0.0;
                    color.rgb = ycbcr_to_rgb(ycbcr.xyz);
                }
            }            
          ]]>
        </shader>
    </GDALImage>
</Map>

samples.description: MapLibre demo vector tiles: https://demotiles.maplibre.org/tiles/tiles.json Requires MVT/Protobuf support and OSGEARTH_ENABLE_SLUGHORN=ON for GPU vector rendering. The XYZ URL uses top-origin {y}; do not invert it. Country polygons and centroids are available at levels 0-6, geographic lines at levels 0-4. Limit source requests while allowing vector atlases to be inherited at closer views. MVT exposes each source-layer name as the mvt_layer feature attribute. Use point symbols for centroids; text symbols would trigger raster fallback.
samples.source:
<!-- MapLibre demo vector tiles: https://demotiles.maplibre.org/tiles/tiles.json
     Requires MVT/Protobuf support and OSGEARTH_ENABLE_SLUGHORN=ON for GPU vector rendering.
     The XYZ URL uses top-origin {y}; do not invert it.
     Country polygons and centroids are available at levels 0-6, geographic lines at levels 0-4. -->
<map name="MapLibre demo - FeatureImage vector mode">
    <XYZFeatures name="maplibre-data">
        <url>https://demotiles.maplibre.org/tiles/tiles.json</url>
    </XYZFeatures>

    <!-- Limit source requests while allowing vector atlases to be inherited at closer views.
         MVT exposes each source-layer name as the mvt_layer feature attribute.
         Use point symbols for centroids; text symbols would trigger raster fallback. -->
    <FeatureImage name="MapLibre world vectors" mode="vector">
        <features>maplibre-data</features>
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css">
                <![CDATA[
                countries {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'countries';
                    fill: #dce5c2;
                    stroke: #64765a;
                    stroke-width: 0.7px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                geolines {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'geolines';
                    stroke: #c07c46;
                    stroke-width: 1px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                centroids {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'centroids';
                    point-fill: #994c3d;
                    point-size: 3;
                }
                ]]>
            </style>
        </styles>
    </FeatureImage>

    <options>
        <terrain color="#a9cee2"/>
    </options>
    <viewpoints home="0" time="0">
        <viewpoint name="World" long="10" lat="20" height="0" heading="0" pitch="-90" range="22000000m"/>
        <viewpoint name="Europe" long="12" lat="48" height="0" heading="0" pitch="-90" range="4500000m"/>

samples.source:
<!-- Run: osgearth_imgui openfreemap_labels.earth
     Requires Prestige, MVT/Protobuf, and OSGEARTH_ENABLE_SLUGHORN=ON; internet access loads live OpenFreeMap tiles.
     Place labels use the new Prestige engine: background decluttering, camera-local history/fades,
     Crowded city/town/neighborhood labels try eight alternatives with batched 1px leaders (12px gap).
     Slughorn analytic fills, and cached distance-field halos. Geometry stays in FeatureImage vector mode.
     Fonts resolve locally (Segoe UI / DejaVu Sans / Liberation Sans / Arial); set <font> to override.
     Unsupported glyph runs are skipped, not rendered with a legacy text fallback. Road names follow paths; no POI icons yet.
     Attribution: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles, and OpenStreetMap contributors (also supplied by TileJSON).
     Place schema: https://openmaptiles.org/docs/schema/#place -->
<map name="OpenFreeMap - Prestige labels" xmlns:prestige="osgEarthPrestige">
    <XYZFeatures name="openfreemap-data">
        <url>https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/latest</url>
        <layers>landcover,landuse,park,water,waterway,building,transportation,boundary</layers>
    </XYZFeatures>

    <!-- Styles paint in document order, with roads above buildings and water.
         Pixel widths are measured at the source tile resolution and scale when overzooming. -->
    <FeatureImage name="OpenFreeMap vectors" mode="vector">
        <features>openfreemap-data</features>
        <background_color>#f2efe9</background_color>
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css"><![CDATA[
                landcover {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'landcover';
                    fill: #dce7cb;
                }
                woodland {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'landcover' && feature.properties['class'] === 'wood';
                    fill: #b8d3a7;
                }
                sand {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'landcover' && feature.properties['class'] === 'sand';
                    fill: #eee1b7;
                }
                ice {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'landcover' && feature.properties['class'] === 'ice';
                    fill: #f4faff;
                }
                landuse {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'landuse';
                    fill: #e5e0d8;
                }
                parks {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'park';
                    fill: #c4dfb2;
                }
                water {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'water';
                    fill: #a9cee2;
                }
                waterways {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'waterway';
                    stroke: #91bdd5;
                    stroke-width: 1px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                buildings {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'building';
                    fill: #d5c5b7;
                    stroke: #b8a596;
                    stroke-width: 0.4px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                paths {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'transportation' &&
                        ['path', 'track', 'pedestrian'].indexOf(feature.properties['class']) >= 0;
                    stroke: #c6ac8e;
                    stroke-width: 0.8px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                minor_roads {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'transportation' &&
                        ['minor', 'service', 'tertiary'].indexOf(feature.properties['class']) >= 0;
                    stroke: #ffffff;
                    stroke-width: 1.5px;
                    stroke-outline: #c7c1b7;
                    stroke-outline-width: 0.4px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                major_roads {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'transportation' &&
                        feature.tile_level >= 8 &&
                        ['primary', 'secondary'].indexOf(feature.properties['class']) >= 0;
                    stroke: #ffe3a3;
                    stroke-width: 2px;
                    stroke-outline: #c5a86d;
                    stroke-outline-width: 0.4px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                highways {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'transportation' &&
                        feature.tile_level >= 7 &&
                        ['motorway', 'trunk'].indexOf(feature.properties['class']) >= 0;
                    stroke: #efba86;
                    stroke-width: 2.5px;
                    stroke-outline: #bd946d;
                    stroke-outline-width: 0.5px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                railways {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'transportation' &&
                        ['rail', 'transit'].indexOf(feature.properties['class']) >= 0;
                    stroke: #8e8b86;
                    stroke-width: 0.7px;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                local_boundaries {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'boundary' &&
                        feature.tile_level >= 10 && feature.properties.maritime != 1 &&
                        feature.properties.admin_level >= 7 && feature.properties.admin_level <= 10;
                    stroke: #b996bd;
                    stroke-width: 0.5px;
                    stroke-opacity: 0.55;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                district_boundaries {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'boundary' &&
                        feature.tile_level >= 7 && feature.properties.maritime != 1 &&
                        feature.properties.admin_level >= 5 && feature.properties.admin_level <= 6;
                    stroke: #b08ab5;
                    stroke-width: 0.65px;
                    stroke-opacity: 0.65;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                regional_boundaries {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'boundary' &&
                        feature.tile_level >= 4 && feature.properties.maritime != 1 &&
                        feature.properties.admin_level >= 3 && feature.properties.admin_level <= 4;
                    stroke: #9b7aa3;
                    stroke-width: 0.8px;
                    stroke-opacity: 0.75;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
                boundaries {
                    select: feature.properties.mvt_layer === 'boundary' &&
                        feature.properties.admin_level == 2 && feature.properties.maritime != 1;
                    stroke: #ad91b1;
                    stroke-width: 1px;
                    stroke-opacity: 0.7;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                }
            ]]></style>
        </styles>
    </FeatureImage>

    <!-- A separate source lets label paging request place and road-name data, independently of terrain paging.
         Source feature IDs identify labels; clipped road fragments are not stitched. No legacy text rasterization. -->
    <XYZFeatures name="openfreemap-labels">
        <url>https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/latest</url>
        <layers>place,transportation_name</layers>
        <l2_cache_size>32</l2_cache_size>
    </XYZFeatures>

    <prestige:labels name="Place and road names">
        <features>openfreemap-labels</features>
        <!-- Extra collision margin on each side of a label, in logical pixels. -->
        <declutter_padding>2</declutter_padding>
        <text_attribute>name</text_attribute>
        <fallback_text_attribute>name</fallback_text_attribute>
        <rank_attribute>rank</rank_attribute>
        <max_level>14</max_level>
        <!-- Smooth GPU road fitting is automatic on OpenGL 4.3+. Set gpu_paths=false to force CPU fitting. -->
        <tile_pixels>512</tile_pixels>
        <!-- TextSymbol CSS plus Prestige text-halo-width in logical pixels; explicit width overrides normalized offset.
             text-halo-softness is Prestige-only: 0 = crisp; 1 = feather across the whole halo radius.
             Pure-white halos are 2 logical pixels wide so they separate labels from the pale basemap.
             Roads use 0.5 softness; places keep crisp halos. pixel_scale applies each camera's device-pixel ratio.
             First matching class/level rule wins. Priority = class priority minus rank (lower rank is better).
             Level limits refer to the label source's Web Mercator tile level; level 14 remains usable when zoomed in. -->
        <styles>
            <style classes="continent" max_level="2" priority="1000">
                text-size: 25; text-fill: #435269;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="country" max_level="6" priority="900">
                text-size: 23; text-fill: #435269;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="state,province" min_level="3" max_level="8" priority="800">
                text-size: 19; text-fill: #64748b;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="city" priority="700">
                text-size: 22; text-fill: #25364a;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="town" min_level="6" priority="600">
                text-size: 19; text-fill: #304157;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="village" min_level="9" priority="500">
                text-size: 17; text-fill: #415066;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="borough,suburb" min_level="10" priority="400">
                text-size: 17; text-fill: #4d5870;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="quarter,neighbourhood,hamlet,isolated_dwelling" min_level="11"
                   priority="300">
                text-size: 15; text-fill: #576177;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="motorway,trunk" placement="line" min_level="10" priority="150">
                text-halo-softness: 0.5;
                text-size: 15; text-fill: #55515a;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="primary,secondary" placement="line" min_level="12" priority="140">
                text-halo-softness: 0.5;
                text-size: 14; text-fill: #55515a;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="tertiary,minor,service,track" placement="line" min_level="14" priority="120">
                text-halo-softness: 0.5;
                text-size: 13; text-fill: #66616a;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
            <style classes="island" min_level="6" priority="200">
                text-size: 17; text-fill: #50685a;
                text-halo: #ffffff; text-halo-width: 2px;
                text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
            </style>
        </styles>
    </prestige:labels>

    <options>
        <terrain color="#f2efe9"/>

<map name="Prestige Demo"
    xmlns:prestige="osgEarthPrestige">

    <xi:include href="readymap_imagery.xml" texture_compression="auto"/>
    <xi:include href="readymap_elevation.xml"/>

    <!-- The Prestige dataset's 3D Tiles hierarchy (written by generate --full, or
       "prestige.py tileset <folder>" for an existing dataset). -->
    <ThreeDTiles name="Prestige Buildings">
        <url>https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/tileset.json</url>
        <!-- The tileset's geometric errors put the switches at LOD1 within 5000m and
         LOD0 within 250m for max_sse 15 in a 1080-pixel-high view. Raise this to
         switch closer, lower it to switch further away. -->
        <max_sse>15</max_sse>
    </ThreeDTiles>

    <prestige:grime name="Grime">
        <opacity>0.5</opacity>
        <model>Prestige Buildings</model>
        <anchor>-71.06,42.36,0</anchor>
        <seed>17</seed>
        <volume_size>128</volume_size>
        <amount>1.0</amount>
        <tint>0.135,0.130,0.124</tint>
        <macro_period>7.5</macro_period>
        <streak_period>1.2,1.2,6.8</streak_period>
        <!-- Start with smoother stains so the change shows on the matte building skins.
          Tune these live in LayersGUI; roughen_only=true is useful for dry deposits. -->
        <roughness>0.25</roughness>
        <roughness_amount>0.8</roughness_amount>
        <roughen_only>false</roughen_only>
        <!-- Smooth materials keep their roughness and receive only 15% of the stain. -->
        <smooth_threshold>0.2</smooth_threshold>
        <smooth_feather>0.15</smooth_feather>
        <smooth_amount>0.15</smooth_amount>
    </prestige:grime>

    <XYZFeatures name="data:osm">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/mbtiles/osm/{z}/{x}/{-y}.pbf</url>
        <min_level>14</min_level>
        <max_level>14</max_level>
        <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
        <format>pbf</format>
        <fid_attribute>@id</fid_attribute>
        <attribution>OpenStreetMap contributors</attribution>
    </XYZFeatures>

    <prestige:vegetation name="Prestige Ground Cover">
        <sources>
            <source name="osm">
                <features>data:osm</features>
            </source>
            <source name="edits">
                <overlay>
                    <type name="clearing" label="Clear vegetation" geometry="polygon">
                        <attribute key="vegetation:exclude" value="yes" />
                    </type>
                    <type name="building" label="Building footprint" geometry="polygon">
                        <attribute key="building" value="yes" />
                    </type>
                    <type name="water" label="Water area" geometry="polygon">
                        <attribute key="natural" value="water" />
                    </type>
                    <type name="path" label="Path (4m buffer each side)" geometry="line">
                        <attribute key="highway" value="path" />
                    </type>
                </overlay>
            </source>
        </sources>
        <!-- Authoring vocabulary only. Matching coverage rules below own buffers and population policy. -->

        <coverage>
            <rule source="edits" key="vegetation:exclude" value="yes" action="exclude"/>
            <!-- Natural populations use OSM. Agricultural groups are included only by their row rules. -->
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="tree" action="points"/>
            <!-- Agriculture replaces background random scatter where OSM land-use polygons overlap woodland. -->
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>

            <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
            <!-- Specific perennial land use overrides any broader farmland polygon in the crop population. -->
            <rule source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="200"/>
            <rule source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="200"/>
            <!-- World mode needs no origin metadata. Spacing and grid-north headings below are visual defaults. -->
            <rule name="osm-orchards" source="osm" group="orchards" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" strategy="rows" priority="100">

            </rule>

                <placement origin_mode="world" heading="75" row_spacing="3" plant_spacing="1.5"/>
            </rule>
            <!-- All populations share OSM exclusions. Explicit mapped trees bypass line buffers; polygon exclusions still apply. -->

            <rule key="natural" value="water" action="exclude"/>
            <rule key="waterway" value="riverbank" action="exclude"/>

samples.title: Prestige Demo
samples.description: OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles / OpenStreetMap contributors. Vector strokes and Prestige labels require OSGEARTH_ENABLE_SLUGHORN=ON. max_level limits visibility as well as paging; boundaries stop after LOD 12. OpenMapTiles ranks 1-10 identify the most important cities. Filtering runs when source tiles load, not during frame rendering. Schema: https://openmaptiles.org/docs/schema/#place Keep paging through 14: the last style ends at 13, so level 14 has no labels. Label levels use source Web Mercator tiles, independently of terrain LOD. Start with smoother stains so the change shows on the matte building skins. Tune these live in LayersGUI; roughen
samples.source:
<map name="Prestige Demo"
    xmlns:prestige="osgEarthPrestige">
  <xi:include href="readymap_imagery.xml" texture_compression="auto" open="true"/>
  <xi:include href="readymap_elevation.xml"/>
  <!-- OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles / OpenStreetMap contributors.
       Vector strokes and Prestige labels require OSGEARTH_ENABLE_SLUGHORN=ON. -->
  <XYZFeatures name="OpenFreeMap administrative boundaries">
    <url>https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/latest</url>
    <layers>boundary</layers>
    <l2_cache_size>32</l2_cache_size>
  </XYZFeatures>

  <!-- max_level limits visibility as well as paging; boundaries stop after LOD 12. -->
  <FeatureImage name="Country and state boundaries" mode="vector" max_level="12">
    <features>OpenFreeMap administrative boundaries</features>
    <styles>
      <style type="text/css"><![CDATA[
        states {
          select: feature.tile_level >= 4 && feature.properties.maritime != 1 &&
              feature.properties.admin_level >= 3 && feature.properties.admin_level <= 4;
          stroke: #ded9cd;
          stroke-width: 0.75px;
          stroke-opacity: 0.45;
          stroke-linecap: round;
          stroke-linejoin: round;
        }
        countries {
          select: feature.properties.admin_level == 2 && feature.properties.maritime != 1;
          stroke: #eee8d9;
          stroke-width: 1px;
          stroke-opacity: 0.6;
          stroke-linecap: round;
          stroke-linejoin: round;
        }
      ]]></style>
    </styles>
  </FeatureImage>

  <XYZFeatures name="OpenFreeMap major places">
    <url>https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/latest</url>
    <layers>place</layers>
    <l2_cache_size>32</l2_cache_size>
    <!-- OpenMapTiles ranks 1-10 identify the most important cities.
         Filtering runs when source tiles load, not during frame rendering.
         Schema: https://openmaptiles.org/docs/schema/#place -->
    <filters>
      <script><![CDATA[
        ['country', 'state', 'province'].indexOf(feature.properties['class']) >= 0 ||
        (feature.properties['class'] === 'city' &&
         feature.properties.rank >= 1 && feature.properties.rank <= 10);
      ]]></script>
    </filters>
  </XYZFeatures>

  <prestige:labels name="Countries, states and major cities">
    <features>OpenFreeMap major places</features>
    <text_attribute>name:en</text_attribute>
    <fallback_text_attribute>name</fallback_text_attribute>
    <rank_attribute>rank</rank_attribute>
    <declutter_padding>3</declutter_padding>
    <tile_pixels>512</tile_pixels>
    <!-- Keep paging through 14: the last style ends at 13, so level 14 has no labels.
         Label levels use source Web Mercator tiles, independently of terrain LOD. -->
    <max_level>14</max_level>
    <styles>
      <style classes="country" min_level="0" max_level="5" priority="900">
        text-size: 22; 
        text-fill: #f5f1e8;
        text-halo: #202832;
        text-halo-width: 1.5px;
        text-halo-softness: 0;
        text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
      </style>
      <style classes="state,province" min_level="4" max_level="8" priority="800">
        text-size: 18;
        text-fill: #e8e6deff;
        text-halo: #202832ff;
        text-halo-width: 1.5;
        text-halo-softness: 0.51999998;
        text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
      </style>
      <style classes="city" min_level="6" max_level="13" priority="700">
        text-size: 14;
        text-fill: #e8e6deff;
        text-halo: #202832ff;
        text-halo-width: 1.64;
        text-halo-softness: 0;
        text-halo-backdrop-type: outline;
      </style>
    </styles>
  </prestige:labels>


  <ThreeDTiles name="Prestige Buildings" caching="true">
    <url>https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/tileset.json</url>
    <max_sse>15</max_sse>
  </ThreeDTiles>
  
  <prestige:grime name="Grime">
    <opacity>0.5</opacity>
    <model>Prestige Buildings</model>
    <anchor>-71.06,42.36,0</anchor>
    <seed>17</seed>
    <volume_size>128</volume_size>
    <amount>1.0</amount>
    <tint>0.135,0.130,0.124</tint>
    <macro_period>7.5</macro_period>
    <streak_period>1.2,1.2,6.8</streak_period>
    <!-- Start with smoother stains so the change shows on the matte building skins.
          Tune these live in LayersGUI; roughen_only=true is useful for dry deposits. -->
    <roughness>0.25</roughness>
    <roughness_amount>0.8</roughness_amount>
    <roughen_only>false</roughen_only>
    <!-- Smooth materials keep their roughness and receive only 15% of the stain. -->
    <smooth_threshold>0.2</smooth_threshold>
    <smooth_feather>0.15</smooth_feather>
    <smooth_amount>0.15</smooth_amount>
  </prestige:grime>
  <XYZFeatures name="data:osm">
    <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/mbtiles/osm/{z}/{x}/{-y}.pbf</url>
    <min_level>14</min_level>
    <max_level>14</max_level>
    <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
    <format>pbf</format>
    <fid_attribute>@id</fid_attribute>
    <attribution>OpenStreetMap contributors</attribution>
  </XYZFeatures>
  <prestige:vegetation name="Prestige Vegetation">
    <sources>
      <source name="osm">
        <features>data:osm</features>
      </source>
      <!--
      <source name="roads">
        <features>Prestige road vectors</features>
      </source>
      -->
      <source name="edits">
        <overlay>
          <type name="clearing" label="Clear vegetation" geometry="polygon">
            <attribute key="vegetation:exclude" value="yes" />
          </type>
          <type name="building" label="Building footprint" geometry="polygon">
            <attribute key="building" value="yes" />
          </type>
          <type name="water" label="Water area" geometry="polygon">
            <attribute key="natural" value="water" />
          </type>
          <type name="path" label="Path (4m buffer each side)" geometry="line">
            <attribute key="highway" value="path" />
          </type>
        </overlay>
      </source>
    </sources>
    <!-- Authoring vocabulary only. Matching coverage rules below own buffers and population policy. -->
    <coverage>
      <rule source="edits" key="vegetation:exclude" value="yes" action="exclude"/>
      <!-- Natural populations use OSM. Agricultural groups are included only by their row rules. -->
      <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="tree" action="points"/>
      <!-- Agriculture replaces background random scatter where OSM land-use polygons overlap woodland. -->
      <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
      <!-- Specific perennial land use overrides any broader farmland polygon in the crop population. -->
      <rule source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" density="0" priority="200"/>
      <rule source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" density="0" priority="200"/>
      <!-- World mode needs no origin metadata. Spacing and grid-north headings below are visual defaults. -->
      <rule name="osm-orchards" source="osm" group="orchards" key="landuse" value="orchard" action="include" strategy="rows" priority="100">
        <placement origin_mode="world" heading="15" row_spacing="10" plant_spacing="7"/>
      </rule>
      <rule name="osm-vineyards" source="osm" group="vineyards" key="landuse" value="vineyard" action="include" strategy="rows" priority="100">
        <placement origin_mode="world" heading="0" heading_attribute="vine_row_orientation" row_spacing="5" plant_spacing="2"/>
      </rule>
      <rule name="osm-crops" source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="farmland" action="include" strategy="rows" priority="100">
        <placement origin_mode="world" heading="75" row_spacing="3" plant_spacing="1.5"/>
      </rule>
      <!-- All populations share OSM exclusions. Explicit mapped trees bypass line buffers; polygon exclusions still apply. -->
      <rule key="building" value="*" except="no" action="exclude"/>
      <rule key="natural" value="water" action="exclude"/>
      <rule key="waterway" value="riverbank" action="exclude"/>
      <!-- Buffer is half-width, in meters; road-class/width attributes can be refined later. -->
      <rule key="highway" value="*" except="no" action="exclude" buffer="4"/>
    </coverage>
    <seed>17</seed>
    <asset_budget_mb>64</asset_budget_mb>
    <assets>
      <asset canopy_trees="5" name="broadleaf" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/broadleaf-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/broadleaf-coarse.osg" canopy="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/broadleaf-canopy.osg"/>
      <asset canopy_trees="5" name="conifer" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/conifer-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/conifer-coarse.osg" canopy="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/conifer-canopy.osg"/>
      <asset name="shrub" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/shrub-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/shrub-coarse.osg"/>
      <asset name="grass-tuft" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/grass-tuft-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/grass-tuft-coarse.osg"/>
      <asset name="fern" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/fern-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/fern-coarse.osg"/>
      <asset name="boulder" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/boulder-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/boulder-coarse.osg"/>
      <asset name="canopy-cluster" near="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/canopy-cluster-near.osg" coarse="../data/prestige/vegetation/pbr/canopy-cluster-coarse.osg"/>
    </assets>
    <profile>global-geodetic</profile>
    <elevation_resolution>10m</elevation_resolution>
    <groups>
      <!-- Coarse render batches support long tree ranges; placement identity remains tied to source cells. -->
      <group name="trees" asset="trees" density="10000" cell_level="16" render_cell_level="14" canopy="true" canopy_far="true" quality_offset="128" canopy_mid_strategy="exact" canopy_far_strategy="coverage" canopy_mid_retention="0.9" canopy_far_retention="0.5" canopy_mid_gpu_culling="true" canopy_far_gpu_culling="true" canopy_transition="0.25" canopy_fade_seconds="0.4" max_range="30000" lod_pixels="96">
        <models>
          <model>broadleaf</model>
          <model>conifer</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <group enabled="false" name="shrubs" asset="shrubs" density="4500" cell_level="18" render_cell_level="16" max_range="700" lod_pixels="48" density_start="150" density_end="550" far_density="0.5">
        <models>
          <model>shrub</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <group enabled="false" name="grass" asset="grass" density="1120000" cell_level="20" render_cell_level="17" max_range="200" lod_pixels="18" density_start="25" density_end="160" far_density="0.2">
        <models>
          <model>grass-tuft</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <group enabled="false" name="undergrowth" asset="undergrowth" density="48000" cell_level="19" render_cell_level="17" max_range="280" lod_pixels="28" density_start="50" density_end="220" far_density="0.35">
        <models>
          <model>fern</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <group name="rocks" enabled="false" asset="rocks" density="1100" cell_level="17" render_cell_level="15" max_range="1000" lod_pixels="40">
        <models>
          <model>boulder</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <!-- Starter proxies make the planting patterns readable; crop/vine art is provisional.
               These populations keep independent controls; coarser render batches suit continuous agricultural coverage. -->
      <group enabled="false" name="orchards" asset="trees" density="1" cell_level="18" render_cell_level="15" max_range="2500" lod_pixels="48" min_scale="0.55" max_scale="0.605">
        <models>
          <model>broadleaf</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <group enabled="false" name="vineyards" asset="shrubs" density="1" cell_level="18" render_cell_level="15" max_range="1200" lod_pixels="24" min_pixels="0.1" min_scale="1.5" max_scale="1.6">
        <models>
          <model>shrub</model>
        </models>
      </group>
      <group enabled="false" name="crop_rows" asset="grass" density="1" cell_level="18" render_cell_level="15" max_range="1000" lod_pixels="12" min_pixels="0.1" min_scale="1.5" max_scale="1.6">

  <MBTilesElevation name="Prestige grading (LOCAL)" open="false">

    <format>tif</format>

  </MBTilesElevation>

    <url>https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/roads/grading/{z}/{x}/{y}.tif</url>
    <profile>global-geodetic</profile>
    <min_level>15</min_level>
    <max_level>15</max_level>
    <tile_size>513</tile_size>
  </XYZElevation>

  <XYZFeatures name="Prestige road vectors (S3)">
    <url>https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/roads/vectors/15/{x}/{y}.fgb</url>
    <format>fgb</format>
    <profile>global-geodetic</profile>
    <min_level>15</min_level>
    <max_level>15</max_level>
  </XYZFeatures>
  

  <!-- Asphalt keeps its textured PBR splatting; the FeatureImage layer below draws gutters, curbs,
       and road markings on top in stylesheet order. -->
  <prestige:surface_splatting name="Prestige asphalt">
    <features>Prestige road vectors (S3)</features>
    <filters>
      <prestige_select attribute="material" values="asphalt" />
    </filters>
    <texture_period>1</texture_period>
    <coverage_outline>false</coverage_outline>
    <!-- Splatting angle cutoff, degrees from level; default 90 disables slope suppression. -->
    <max_slope>90</max_slope>
    <min_level>15</min_level>
    <max_data_level>17</max_data_level>
    <tile_size>512</tile_size>
    <buffer_width>0m</buffer_width>
    <material color="https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/roads/materials/asphalt-color.png" packed="https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/roads/materials/asphalt-pbr.png" normal="https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/roads/materials/asphalt-normal.png" displacement="https://pelican-prestige.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prestige/roads/materials/asphalt-height.png" layout="orm" />
    <cache_policy usage="no_cache" />
  </prestige:surface_splatting>

  <!-- Raster comparison uses the same source, styles, and data LODs as the vector layer above.
       Enable one comparison layer at a time in LayersGUI to compare rendering and frame rate. -->
  <FeatureImage name="Prestige road surfaces (raster)" mode="raster" min_level="16" max_data_level="18" buffer_width="5m" visible="true" min_range="125">    
    <features>Prestige road vectors (S3)</features>
    <styles>
      <style type="text/css">
        <![CDATA[
          gutter {
            select: feature.properties.material === 'gutter';
            stroke: #aaa69c;
            stroke-width: feature.properties.width;
            stroke-width-units: meters;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
          }
          curb {
            select: feature.properties.material === 'curb';
            stroke: #cbc6b8;
            stroke-width: feature.properties.width;
            stroke-width-units: meters;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
          }
          white {
            select: feature.properties.material === 'white';
            stroke: #f2f2ee;
            stroke-width: feature.properties.width;
            stroke-width-units: meters;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
          }
          yellow {
            select: feature.properties.material === 'yellow';
            stroke: #e8c23a;
            stroke-width: feature.properties.width;
            stroke-width-units: meters;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
          }
        ]]>
      </style>
    </styles>
    <cache_policy usage="no_cache" />
  </FeatureImage>

  <!-- Curbs, gutters, and road markings as GPU strokes (build with OSGEARTH_ENABLE_SLUGHORN=ON).
       Re-exported centerlines carry material and width (full stroke width in meters).
       Styles below control the active materials and their cap settings.
       Source features exist at LOD 15; vector atlases are built at LOD 17 and inherited by finer terrain. -->

  <prestige:vegetation name="Prestige Ground Cover">
      <sources>
          <source name="osm">
              <features>data:osm</features>
          </source>
          <source name="edits">
              <overlay>
                  <type name="clearing" label="Clear vegetation" geometry="polygon">
                      <attribute key="vegetation:exclude" value="yes" />
                  </type>
                  <type name="building" label="Building footprint" geometry="polygon">
                      <attribute key="building" value="yes" />
                  </type>
                  <type name="water" label="Water area" geometry="polygon">
                      <attribute key="natural" value="water" />
                  </type>
                  <type name="path" label="Path (4m buffer each side)" geometry="line">
                      <attribute key="highway" value="path" />
                  </type>
              </overlay>
          </source>
      </sources>
      <!-- Authoring vocabulary only. Matching coverage rules below own buffers and population policy. -->

      <coverage>
          <rule source="edits" key="vegetation:exclude" value="yes" action="exclude"/>
          <!-- Natural populations use OSM. Agricultural groups are included only by their row rules. -->
          <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="natural" value="wood" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="tree" action="points"/>
          <!-- Agriculture replaces background random scatter where OSM land-use polygons overlap woodland. -->
          <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="orchard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="vineyard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="farmland"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="orchard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="vineyard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="shrubs" key="landuse" value="farmland"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="orchard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="vineyard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="grass" key="landuse" value="farmland"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="orchard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="vineyard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="undergrowth" key="landuse" value="farmland"
              action="include" density="0" priority="100"/>
          <!-- Specific perennial land use overrides any broader farmland polygon in the crop population. -->
          <rule source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="orchard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="200"/>
          <rule source="osm" group="crop_rows" key="landuse" value="vineyard"
              action="include" density="0" priority="200"/>
          <!-- World mode needs no origin metadata. Spacing and grid-north headings below are visual defaults. -->
          <rule name="osm-orchards" source="osm" group="orchards" key="landuse"

              <placement origin_mode="world" heading="15" row_spacing="10" plant_spacing="7"/>
          </rule>
          <rule name="osm-vineyards" source="osm" group="vineyards" key="landuse"
              value="vineyard" action="include" strategy="rows" priority="100">
              <placement origin_mode="world" heading="0" heading_attribute="vine_row_orientation"

          </rule>

          </rule>
          <!-- All populations share OSM exclusions. Explicit mapped trees bypass line buffers; polygon exclusions still apply. -->

          <!-- geometry="polygon" skips water centerlines; without it, a rule uses every part its action can

          <rule key="natural" value="water" action="exclude" geometry="polygon"/>
          <rule key="waterway" value="riverbank" action="exclude"/>
          <!-- Buffer is half-width, in meters; road-class/width attributes can be refined later. -->

      <elevation_resolution>10m</elevation_resolution>
      <groups>

          <group name="trees" asset="trees" density="10000" cell_level="16" render_cell_level="14"

<!--
Whole-earth OSM road flattening with osgEarthPrestige.

Run: osgearth_imgui prestige_grading.earth
Tools > Map: toggle "Prestige road grading" for the before/after comparison.
Turn off "ReadyMap imagery" to inspect the illuminated terrain surface alone.
Tools > Viewpoints: select the road close-up, regional views, or whole earth.

Network data: ReadyMap imagery/OSM/elevation; optional public Terrarium elevation.
OSM attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
ReadyMap service terms: https://readymap.org

The OSM service clips geometries at vector-tile edges. This is an exploratory
demo; continuous smoothed road profiles across those source boundaries are not
yet guaranteed. Bridges, tunnels, pedestrian paths, and highway areas are excluded.

Inland water (rivers, streams, canals, ponds, lakes) is graded first: channels lose
bridge/culvert bumps and never rise downstream; water bodies are level with banks no
steeper than the bank slope. Road grading follows and samples the water-graded terrain.
-->
<map name="Prestige - OSM road flattening" xmlns:prestige="osgEarthPrestige">

    <prestige:sky/>

    <TMSImage name="ReadyMap imagery">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/7/</url>
        <attribution>ReadyMap(R) by Pelican Mapping</attribution>
    </TMSImage>

    <xi:include href="readymap_elevation.xml"/>

    <!-- Optional alternate DEM. Enable before comparing and let the terrain refresh.
         max_data_level preserves fallback when viewing more detailed terrain tiles. -->
    <XYZElevation name="Terrarium terrain (optional)" open="false">
        <url>https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/{z}/{x}/{y}.png</url>
        <elevation_encoding>terrarium</elevation_encoding>
        <max_level>23</max_level>
        <max_data_level>13</max_data_level>
        <stitch_edges>true</stitch_edges>
        <vdatum>egm96</vdatum>
    </XYZElevation>

    <XYZFeatures name="OSM inland water">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/mbtiles/osm/{z}/{x}/{-y}.pbf</url>
        <min_level>14</min_level>
        <max_level>14</max_level>
        <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
        <format>pbf</format>
        <fid_attribute>@id</fid_attribute>
        <l2_cache_size>128</l2_cache_size>
        <attribution>OpenStreetMap contributors</attribution>
        <filters>
            <script language="javascript"><![CDATA[
                (["river", "stream", "canal", "drain", "ditch"].indexOf(feature.properties.waterway) >= 0 &&
                 (!feature.properties.tunnel || feature.properties.tunnel === "no") &&
                 feature.properties.intermittent !== "yes") ||
                feature.properties.natural === "water" || feature.properties.waterway === "riverbank" ||
                feature.properties.landuse === "reservoir";
            ]]></script>
        </filters>
    </XYZFeatures>

    <!-- Water before roads. Lines are channels (width and bed depth by type); polygons are level bodies.
         Water grading must not follow road grading, or banks could cut graded shoreline roads. -->
    <prestige:grading name="Prestige water grading" features="OSM inland water"
                        min_level="14" max_data_level="14">
        <policy>water</policy>
        <line_width>({"river": 12, "canal": 8, "stream": 3, "drain": 2, "ditch": 1.5})[feature.properties.waterway] || 4</line_width>
        <depth>({"river": 1.5, "canal": 1, "stream": 0.5, "drain": 0.4, "ditch": 0.3})[feature.properties.waterway] || 0.6</depth>
        <buffer_width>50</buffer_width>
        <bank_slope>0.4</bank_slope>
        <flowing>["river", "canal", "stream", "rapids"].indexOf(feature.properties.water) >= 0 || feature.properties.waterway === "riverbank"</flowing>
        <max_line_width>20</max_line_width>
        <max_buffer_width>50</max_buffer_width>
        <sample_spacing>5</sample_spacing>
        <smoothing_distance>30</smoothing_distance>
        <elevation_resolution>5</elevation_resolution>
        <flow_window>200</flow_window>
        <water_level_radius>200</water_level_radius>
    </prestige:grading>

    <XYZFeatures name="OSM surface roads">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/mbtiles/osm/{z}/{x}/{-y}.pbf</url>
        <min_level>14</min_level>
        <max_level>14</max_level>
        <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
        <format>pbf</format>
        <fid_attribute>@id</fid_attribute>
        <l2_cache_size>128</l2_cache_size>
        <attribution>OpenStreetMap contributors</attribution>
        <filters>
            <script language="javascript"><![CDATA[
                ["motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary",
                 "motorway_link", "trunk_link", "primary_link", "secondary_link", "tertiary_link",
                 "residential", "unclassified", "living_street", "service"].indexOf(feature.properties.highway) >= 0 &&
                (!feature.properties.bridge || feature.properties.bridge === "no") &&
                (!feature.properties.tunnel || feature.properties.tunnel === "no") &&
                feature.properties.area !== "yes";
            ]]></script>
            <!-- Infer once before source caching; terrain and imagery share the metric attribute. -->
            <prestige_osm_road_width attribute="oe_road_width" lane_width="3.5" max_width="40"/>
        </filters>
    </XYZFeatures>

    <!-- Elevation must precede flattening. Widths are ground meters at every latitude.
         max_line_width must cover the feature filter's max_width above. -->
    <prestige:grading name="Prestige road grading" features="OSM surface roads"
                        min_level="14" max_data_level="14">
        <line_width>feature.properties.oe_road_width</line_width>
        <buffer_width>20</buffer_width>
        <max_line_width>40</max_line_width>
        <max_buffer_width>20</max_buffer_width>
        <sample_spacing>5</sample_spacing>
        <smoothing_distance>30</smoothing_distance>
        <elevation_resolution>5</elevation_resolution>
    </prestige:grading>

    <!-- Raster imagery follows the modified terrain automatically when flattening is toggled. -->
    <FeatureImageRTT name="OSM road surface" features="OSM surface roads"
                 min_level="14" max_data_level="19" tile_size="512">
        <!-- Include centerlines just outside the image tile when their wide strokes overlap it. -->
        <buffer_width>40m</buffer_width>
        <styles>
            <style type="text/css"><![CDATA[
                default {
                    stroke: #ffffff;
                    stroke-width: feature.properties.oe_road_width;
                    stroke-width-units: meters;
                    stroke-image: "'../data/road.png'";
                    stroke-linejoin: round;
                    stroke-linecap: round;
                    stroke-tessellation-size: 5m;
                }
            ]]></style>
        </styles>
    </FeatureImageRTT>

    <viewpoints home="0" map_keys="true" time="2">

                   height="921.1276" heading="-27.1632" pitch="-27.8402" range="266.039"/>
