<!-- NYC integration demo. Requires the generated road-grading-nyc and render-fixture-nyc packages.
     Buildings retain their authored elevations; vegetation samples the composed graded terrain.
     Launch with the companion view_prestige_nyc.ps1 script. -->
<map xmlns:prestige="osgEarthPrestige" name="Prestige NYC - graded roads, buildings, vegetation and sky">
    <options>
        <terrain color="#bcc0b7" tile_size="17" screen_space_error="8" max_lod="22" min_tile_range_factor="7" />
    </options>
    <TMSImage name="ReadyMap imagery">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/7/</url>
        <texture_compression>auto</texture_compression>
    </TMSImage>
    <TMSElevation name="ReadyMap elevation / unchanged">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/116/</url>
        <vdatum>egm96</vdatum>
    </TMSElevation>
    <OGRFeatures name="Compiled road profiles">
        <url>../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/road-grading-nyc/road-profiles.geojson</url>
    </OGRFeatures>
    <prestige:grading name="Single-LOD road grading" features="Compiled road profiles" open="true">
        <road_footprints>true</road_footprints>
        <min_level>16</min_level>
        <max_data_level>16</max_data_level>
        <tile_size>257</tile_size>
        <junction>[grading_junction]</junction>
        <profile_id_attribute>source_way_ids</profile_id_attribute>
        <junction_transition>30</junction_transition>
        <line_width>[profile_search_width_m]</line_width>
        <buffer_width>5</buffer_width>
        <max_line_width>500</max_line_width>
        <max_buffer_width>5</max_buffer_width>
        <sample_spacing>10</sample_spacing>
        <smoothing_distance>30</smoothing_distance>
        <elevation_resolution>5</elevation_resolution>
    </prestige:grading>
    <OGRFeatures name="compiled-asphalt">
        <url>../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/render-fixture-nyc/render-contract/asphalt.gpkg</url>
        <attribution>OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL; inferred road dimensions</attribution>
    </OGRFeatures>
    <prestige:surface_splatting name="Prestige asphalt" features="compiled-asphalt">
        <anchor>-73.995,40.7095,0</anchor>
        <texture_period>1.0</texture_period>
        <normal_strength>1</normal_strength>
        <material
            color="../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/bridge-boston-congress/materials/asphalt-color.png"
            packed="../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/bridge-boston-congress/materials/asphalt-orm.png"
            layout="orm" />
        <min_level>15</min_level>
        <tile_size>512</tile_size>
        <max_data_level>19</max_data_level>
        <buffer_width>2m</buffer_width>
        <cache_policy usage="no_cache" />
    </prestige:surface_splatting>
    <OGRFeatures name="paint-yellow">
        <url>../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/render-fixture-nyc/render-contract/yellow.geojson</url>
    </OGRFeatures>
    <prestige:surface_splatting name="Paint yellow" features="paint-yellow">
        <anchor>-73.995,40.7095,0</anchor>
        <texture_period>1</texture_period>
        <coverage_outline>false</coverage_outline>
        <material
            color="../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/bridge-boston-congress/materials/yellow-color.png"
            packed="../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/bridge-boston-congress/materials/yellow-orm.png"
            layout="orm" />
        <min_level>15</min_level>
        <tile_size>512</tile_size>
        <max_data_level>21</max_data_level>
        <buffer_width>2m</buffer_width>
        <cache_policy usage="no_cache" />
    </prestige:surface_splatting>
    <OGRFeatures name="paint-white">
        <url>../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/render-fixture-nyc/render-contract/white.geojson</url>
    </OGRFeatures>
    <prestige:surface_splatting name="Paint white" features="paint-white">
        <anchor>-73.995,40.7095,0</anchor>
        <texture_period>1</texture_period>
        <coverage_outline>false</coverage_outline>
        <material
            color="../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/bridge-boston-congress/materials/white-color.png"
            packed="../tools/experiments/prestige_roads/output/bridge-boston-congress/materials/white-orm.png"
            layout="orm" />
        <min_level>15</min_level>
        <tile_size>512</tile_size>
        <max_data_level>21</max_data_level>
        <buffer_width>2m</buffer_width>
        <cache_policy usage="no_cache" />
    </prestige:surface_splatting>
    <prestige:prestige name="Prestige Buildings">
        <url>D:/data/prestige/Prestige_ktx/models/prestige/</url>
        <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
        <additive>false</additive>
        <lod0_extension>gltf</lod0_extension>
        <lod_method>screen_space</lod_method>
        <min_level>14</min_level>
        <max_level>14</max_level>
        <lod1_range>5000</lod1_range>
        <lod0_range>250</lod0_range>
        <skip_lod1>false</skip_lod1>
        <split>true</split>
        <subdivide>true</subdivide>
        <invert_y>false</invert_y>
    </prestige:prestige>
    <XYZFeatures name="data:osm">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/mbtiles/osm/{z}/{x}/{-y}.pbf</url>
        <min_level>14</min_level>
        <max_level>14</max_level>
        <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
        <format>pbf</format>
        <fid_attribute>@id</fid_attribute>
        <attribution>OpenStreetMap contributors</attribution>
    </XYZFeatures>
    <prestige:vegetation name="Prestige vegetation on graded elevation">
        <sources>
            <source name="osm">
                <features>data:osm</features>
            </source>
            <source name="roads">
                <features>compiled-asphalt</features>
            </source>
        </sources>
        <coverage>
            <!--Park trees are inferred at 8% of the woodland population density.-->
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="leisure" value="park" action="include" density="0.08" />
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="wood" action="include" />
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="landuse" value="forest" action="include" />
            <rule source="osm" group="trees" key="natural" value="tree" action="points" />
            <rule key="building" value="*" except="no" action="exclude" />
            <rule key="natural" value="water" action="exclude" />
            <rule key="waterway" value="riverbank" action="exclude" />
            <rule key="highway" value="*" except="no" action="exclude" buffer="4" />
            <rule source="roads" key="material" value="asphalt" action="exclude" />
        </coverage>
        <seed>17</seed>
        <asset_budget_mb>64</asset_budget_mb>
        <assets>
            <asset
                canopy_trees="5"
                name="broadleaf"
                near="../data/procedural2/pbr/broadleaf-near.osg"
                coarse="../data/procedural2/pbr/broadleaf-coarse.osg"
                canopy="../data/procedural2/pbr/broadleaf-canopy.osg" />
            <asset
                canopy_trees="5"
                name="conifer"
                near="../data/procedural2/pbr/conifer-near.osg"
                coarse="../data/procedural2/pbr/conifer-coarse.osg"
                canopy="../data/procedural2/pbr/conifer-canopy.osg" />
        </assets>
        <profile>global-geodetic</profile>
        <elevation_resolution>1m</elevation_resolution>
        <groups>
            <group
                name="trees"
                asset="trees"
                density="10000"
                cell_level="16"
                render_cell_level="14"
                canopy="true"
                canopy_far="true"
                quality_offset="128"
                canopy_mid_strategy="exact"
                canopy_far_strategy="coverage"
                canopy_mid_retention="0.9"
                canopy_far_retention="0.5"
                canopy_mid_gpu_culling="true"
                canopy_far_gpu_culling="true"
                canopy_transition="0.25"
                canopy_fade_seconds="0.4"
                max_range="30000"
                lod_pixels="96">
                <models>
                    <model>broadleaf</model>
                    <model>conifer</model>
                </models>
            </group>
        </groups>
    </prestige:vegetation>
    <prestige:sky preset="balanced" />
    <viewpoints home="0" time="2">
        <viewpoint
            name="Lower Manhattan - graded roads and Prestige"
            long="-74.0014"
            lat="40.7129"
            height="5"
            heading="25"
            pitch="-38"
            range="1350" />
        <viewpoint
            name="Repaired road junction"
            long="-74.0021038"
            lat="40.7151561"
            height="-12.971129"
            heading="40"
            pitch="-45"
            range="240" />
        <viewpoint name="City Hall Park" long="-74.0060" lat="40.7126" height="0" heading="25" pitch="-30" range="550" />
        <viewpoint
            name="Two-kilometer road fixture"
            long="-73.995"
            lat="40.7095"
            height="0"
            heading="0"
            pitch="-65"
            range="2400" />
    </viewpoints>
</map>

        <styles>

                    stroke-width: 8m;
                    stroke-linejoin: miter;
                    stroke-linecap: flat;
                    stroke-image: "'../data/road.png'";

samples.source:
<!--
Demo of shared layers. This will render the earth imagery without the oceans.
It will work with either GL3 or NVGL terrain rendering.
Note the use of the oe_use_shared_layer pragma to call out the shared names.
-->
<map>
    <TMSImage name="ocean_mask" visible="false" shared="true">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/2/</url>
        <shared_sampler>mask_tex</shared_sampler>
        <shared_matrix>mask_mat</shared_matrix>
    </TMSImage>
    <TMSImage name="imagery">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/7/</url>
        <shader>
            <![CDATA[
            #pragma vp_function mask_me, fragment    
            #pragma oe_use_shared_layer(mask_tex, mask_mat)
            in vec4 oe_layer_tilec;
            
            void mask_me(inout vec4 color)
            {
                vec4 mask = texture(mask_tex, (mask_mat*oe_layer_tilec).st);
                if (mask.a > 0.75)
                    discard;
            }
        ]]></shader>
    </TMSImage>
</map>

samples.title: Current Weather
samples.description: osgEarth Sample Weather (RADAR and IR) overlaid on the map. GlobalIR Imgery from http://realearth.ssec.wisc.edu/ NEXRAD 45 minute RADAR returns US State Boundaries
samples.source:
<!--
osgEarth Sample
Weather (RADAR and IR) overlaid on the map.
-->

<map name="Current Weather">

    <TMSImage name="ReadyMap 15m Imagery">
        <url>https://readymap.org/readymap/tiles/1.0.0/7/</url>
    </TMSImage>

    <!-- GlobalIR Imgery from http://realearth.ssec.wisc.edu/ -->	
    <XYZImage name="GlobalIR" async="true">
        <url>http://realearth.ssec.wisc.edu/tiles/globalir/{z}/{x}/{y}.png</url>                
        <profile>spherical-mercator</profile>
        <cache_policy usage="no_cache"/>
        <shader>
            <![CDATA[
            #version 330
            #pragma vp_entryPoint adjustAlpha
            #pragma vp_location fragment_coloring
            void adjustAlpha(inout vec4 color) {
                color.a *= clamp(distance(color.rgb, vec3(0.0)), 0.0, 1.0);
                color.a = pow(color.a, 4.0);
            }
          ]]>
        </shader>
        <altitude>10000</altitude>
    </XYZImage>

    <!-- NEXRAD 45 minute RADAR returns -->
    <WMSImage name="nexrad45min" async="true">
        <url>http://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cgi-bin/wms/nexrad/n0r.cgi</url>
        <format>png</format>
        <layers>nexrad-n0r</layers>
        <tile_size>256</tile_size>
        <srs>EPSG:4326</srs>
        <transparent>true</transparent>
        <cache_policy usage="no_cache"/>
        <altitude>20000</altitude>
    </WMSImage>

    <!-- US State Boundaries -->
    <FeatureModel name="US States">
        <OGRFeatures name="US-Data">
            <url>../data/usa.shp</url>
        </OGRFeatures>
        <style type="text/css">
            states {
               stroke: #7f7f7f; 
               stroke-width: 2px;
               render-depth-offset: true;
            }                    
        </style>  
    </FeatureModel>
</map>
